subject: Special pricing request — MedSys (hosted API)
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Chen <sarah.chen@medsys.io>
Cc: Aaron Patel <aaron.patel@medsys.io>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Special pricing request — MedSys (hosted API)

Hi Sarah / Aaron,

Thanks again for the conversation last week — team is excited by the pilot metrics. As discussed, MedSys is looking to move production traffic for the core clinical summarization feature to Redwood Hosted API. Your run-rate during the trial suggests a steady monthly token consumption around 120M tokens with 20–30% growth over the next six months.

You asked for an enterprise quote and whether we can support an upfront committed program with a stepped discount. I attached a brief usage forecast and a draft MSA to get the contracting conversation started.

Can you confirm the desired commitment term (12 vs 24 months) and whether you need invoicing on net-45 or net-30? If you confirm a 24-month commitment and prepayment for the first 6 months, we can be competitive on price.

Happy to set a short call tomorrow to align on numbers.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0173

Attachments: MedSys_Usage_Forecast_Q3-Q4.xlsx, MedSys_Draft_MSA_v1.pdf

From: Sarah Chen <sarah.chen@medsys.io>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Special pricing request — MedSys (hosted API)

Vanessa,

Thanks — we reviewed the forecast internally. Short version: budget is tight for FY27. MedSys can commit to a 24-month deal, expected steady-state spend ~140M tokens/month, but we need a significant unit price reduction compared to list.

Specifically, would Redwood consider a 40% off-list unit price for the first 12 months (then revert to a 15% renewal discount), in exchange for a 24-month commitment and a 6-month prepayment? Legal will want standard MSA redlines but that is manageable.

If Redwood can do that, we can align procurement and legal quickly — target to sign by the end of June.

Regards,
Sarah Chen
Head of Product Operations, MedSys
+sarah.chen@medsys.io

--

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: FW: Special pricing request — MedSys (hosted API) 

Team — escalating for deal-desk / exec consideration. MedSys (large regional health system) has asked for 40% off-list on Hosted API unit pricing for the first 12 months in exchange for:
- 24-month contract
- ~140M tokens/month steady state (growth to 160M)
- 6-month prepayment

Rationale for aggressive concession: 1) high projected steady usage reduces unit cost risk long-term; 2) strategic reference customer in clinical space (opens vertical GTM); 3) they are willing to sign quickly (end of June).

Proposed concession structure: 40% off list for months 1–12 (promotional), 15% off list months 13–24, with a minimum monthly committed spend floor of $X (see attached comparator). We can tighten SLA credits and require prepayment to protect unit economics.

Ask: need approval to offer the 40% promotional discount and sign off on net-45 vs net-30 terms. Legal will need to prep redline of MSA and Finance (Lauren) to confirm impact to cashflow and revenue recognition.

If possible, need a decision by EOD Tue 15 Jun to keep the June sign-by target.

Thanks — Vanessa

Attachments: Pricing_Request_Comparator.xlsx

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FW: Special pricing request — MedSys (hosted API)

Vanessa / team — I reviewed the ask and the supporting forecast. Approve exception to offer up to 40% promotional discount for months 1–12 under these hard conditions:

1) Customer signs a 24-month MSA with a minimum committed monthly spend set at the modeled steady-state (no less than the forecasted floor).
2) Customer provides 6 months prepayment or an executed purchase order guaranteeing the prepayment schedule; Finance to confirm acceptable prepayment terms.
3) Redwood legal to insert a promotional-rate clause that explicitly states the promotional period and automatic reversion to the negotiated renewal rate.
4) No additional commercial concessions (credits, free trials, or expanded support) outside of standard onboarding.

Lauren — please confirm revenue recognition and cashflow impact on the proposed schedule. Karthik / Marissa — once Finance/legal confirm, Vanessa move to execute and get countersignature.

Markus
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Chen <sarah.chen@medsys.io>
Cc: Aaron Patel <aaron.patel@medsys.io>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Special pricing request — MedSys (hosted API)

Sarah — good news: leadership has approved a promotional structure that matches your ask, subject to standard finance and legal confirmations. Summary of approved commercial terms:

- Promotional unit price: 40% off list for months 1–12.
- Renewal: 15% off list for months 13–24.
- Commitment: 24-month MSA with committed monthly spend floor (we'll insert the modeled floor into the SOW).
- Payment: 6 months prepayment required prior to go-live (Finance to provide invoicing instructions).
- Promo clause and automatic reversion to renewal price to be included in the MSA.

Next steps: our legal team will send a redline of the MSA today and Finance will follow up with a proforma invoice for the prepayment. Please confirm the final billing contact and any PO number you will need so we can expedite. Target: countersigned agreement by 30 Jun.

Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
